tmux@local mux_command = ["tmux", "-L", "LAUNCH-SOCK", "-V"]
tmux@local stamps_per_window = true
tmux@local command_lists = true
tmux@local size_reports = true
tmux@local implicit_attach = true
tmux@local strict_blocks = true
tmux@local subscriptions = true
tmux@local asks_server_version = false
tmux@local paste_channel = false
tmux@local kill_remembered_when_ambiguous = false
tmux@local hook_poll = false
tmux@local window_command tb-demo = /opt/agent/claude --resume 'it'\''s x'
tmux@local birth tb-demo = ["set-window-option remain-on-exit on", "set-window-option window-size manual"]
tmux@local window_command tbs-demo = /opt/agent/claude --resume 'it'\''s x'
tmux@local birth tbs-demo = ["set-window-option remain-on-exit off", "set-window-option window-size manual"]
tmux@local window_command tbp-x-y = /opt/agent/claude --resume 'it'\''s x'
tmux@local birth tbp-x-y = ["set-window-option remain-on-exit off", "set-window-option window-size manual"]
tmux@local quote_arg "tb-demo" = tb-demo
tmux@local quote_arg "/tmp/my dir" = '/tmp/my dir'
tmux@local quote_arg "it's" = 'it'\''s'
tmux@local env_args = " -e A=1"
tmux@local send_keys "ls\r" = ["send-keys -t %1 -H 6c 73 0d\n"]
tmux@local send_keys "\u{1b}[A" = ["send-keys -t %1 -H 1b 5b 41\n"]
tmux@local send_keys "it's -x 0x41" = ["send-keys -t %1 -H 69 74 27 73 20 2d 78 20 30 78 34 31\n"]
tmux@local send_keys "ééé" = ["send-keys -t %1 -H c3 a9 c3 a9 c3 a9\n"]
tmux@local send_keys "\u{1b}[200~a\nb\u{1b}[201~" = ["send-keys -t %1 -H 1b 5b 32 30 30 7e 61 0a 62 1b 5b 32 30 31 7e\n"]
tmux@local resize = (["set-option -F -w -t %1 @thurbox_sizer '#{?#{||:#{==:#{session_attached},1},#{||:#{==:#{@thurbox_sizer},},#{==:#{@thurbox_sizer},SIZER}}},SIZER,#{@thurbox_sizer}}'", "if-shell -F -t %1 '#{==:#{@thurbox_sizer},SIZER}' 'resize-window -t %1 -x 120 -y 40' 'display-message -p \"\"'", "if-shell -F -t %1 '#{==:#{@thurbox_sizer},SIZER}' 'resize-pane -t %1 -x 120 -y 40' 'display-message -p \"\"'"], 5)
tmux@local resize clamped = (["set-option -F -w -t %1 @thurbox_sizer '#{?#{||:#{==:#{session_attached},1},#{||:#{==:#{@thurbox_sizer},},#{==:#{@thurbox_sizer},SIZER}}},SIZER,#{@thurbox_sizer}}'", "if-shell -F -t %1 '#{==:#{@thurbox_sizer},SIZER}' 'resize-window -t %1 -x 10000 -y 1' 'display-message -p \"\"'", "if-shell -F -t %1 '#{==:#{@thurbox_sizer},SIZER}' 'resize-pane -t %1 -x 10000 -y 1' 'display-message -p \"\"'"], 5)
tmux@local paste_args = ["send-keys", "-t", "thurbox:tb-demo", "-l", "\u{1b}[200~line one\nline two\u{1b}[201~"]
tmux@local check_banner "tmux 3.4" = ok
tmux@local check_server_version "tmux 3.4" = ok
tmux@local check_banner "tmux 2.8" = err: tmux 2.8 is too old; thurbox requires >= 3.2
tmux@local check_server_version "tmux 2.8" = ok
tmux@local check_banner "tmux 3.3.6" = ok
tmux@local check_server_version "tmux 3.3.6" = ok
tmux@local check_banner "psmux 3.3.8" = ok
tmux@local check_server_version "psmux 3.3.8" = ok
tmux@local check_banner "3.3.6" = ok
tmux@local check_server_version "3.3.6" = ok
tmux@local check_banner "" = ok
tmux@local check_server_version "" = ok
tmux@ssh mux_command = ["ssh", "-o", "BatchMode=yes", "-o", "ConnectTimeout=5", "-o", "ServerAliveInterval=5", "-o", "ServerAliveCountMax=1", "-o", "ControlMaster=auto", "-o", "ControlPersist=60", "-o", "ControlPath=~/.ssh/thurbox-%C", "me@devbox", "tmux", "-L", "LAUNCH-SOCK", "-V"]

psmux@local check_banner "tmux 2.8" = err: psmux 2.8.0 is too old: its server can start an agent with a stdin that is not its pane ("stdin is unreadable (EISDIR)"). Upgrade psmux to 3.3.7 or newer, then restart its server (`psmux -L VERSION-SOCK kill-server`) — a running server keeps the old code
psmux@local check_server_version "tmux 2.8" = err: psmux 2.8.0 is too old: its server can start an agent with a stdin that is not its pane ("stdin is unreadable (EISDIR)").
